E0109

`+` can't compare or combine Int (a whole number) and String (text)

What

`+` can't compare or combine Int (a whole number) and String (text)

Why

The operator has no built-in rule and no user-defined `impl Type.Trait` hook for this operand pair

Fix

Use a supported operand pair, call a named method, or implement the operator's hook trait on your own type for this pair

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0109: tests/ui/approx_nonnumeric.stderr.

Error [E0109]: `approx` needs a whole number, but this is String (text)
  --> tests/ui/approx_nonnumeric.jet:2:17
    |
  2 |     _ :: approx("not a number")
    |                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `approx(value)` only opts one integer-to-float crossing out of its exactness check
 Fix: Remove `approx`, or pass a whole number that is crossing into a decimal
